pt-PT.text: This Pokémon was discovered during deep-sea exploration. Its appearance hasn’t changed in 100,000,000 years, so it’s called a living fossil.

zh-CN.text: 在深海调查中被发现的宝可梦。样子在１亿年间都没有任何变化，被人们称为活化石。

de-DE.text: Es lebt in den Korallenriffen warmer Meere und schläft besonders gern zwischen den Armen von Corasonn.

en-US.text: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola’s branches.

es-ES.text: Vive en los arrecifes de coral de mares cálidos. Dormir entre las ramas de los Corsola es algo por lo que siente una especial predilección.

fr-FR.text: Il vit dans les récifs coralliens des mers chaudes, et aime particulièrement dormir entre les cornes des Corayon.

it-IT.text: Vive nelle barriere coralline dei mari caldi. Ama particolarmente dormire fra le ramificazioni dei Corsola.

pt-PT.text: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola’s branches.

zh-CN.text: 温暖海域的珊瑚礁是它的栖息地。特别喜欢在太阳珊瑚的枝条间睡觉。

de-DE.text: Es lebt in Einsamkeit, ohne Gruppen zu bilden. Sein steinharter Schädel kann mit einem Schlag einen massiven Felsen entzweihauen.

en-US.text: Bagon is a solitary Pokémon that doesn’t form groups with others of its kind. It also has a head hard enough to cleave a boulder in one strike.

es-ES.text: Vive en solitario, sin formar manadas, y posee una cabeza dura como la piedra que le permite hacer añicos rocas enormes de un solo golpe.

fr-FR.text: La tête de ce Pokémon solitaire est si solide qu’il est capable de fendre en deux un rocher d’un seul coup.

it-IT.text: Vive in solitudine senza formare branchi. È dotato di una testa così dura da poter spaccare in due rocce granitiche con un solo colpo.

pt-PT.text: Bagon is a solitary Pokémon that doesn’t form groups with others of its kind. It also has a head hard enough to cleave a boulder in one strike.

zh-CN.text: 不会成群结队，喜欢单独生活。脑袋很硬，只要猛地一撞，就能把坚硬的岩石一分为二。

de-DE.text: Es ignoriert sein Hungergefühl und isst nichts. Draschels Entwicklung setzt anscheinend ein, wenn all seine Energiereserven aufgebraucht sind.

en-US.text: Shelgon ignores its hunger entirely, never eating any food. Apparently, Shelgon will evolve once all its energy stores are used up.

es-ES.text: Aguanta el hambre sin comer nada. Al parecer, inicia el proceso evolutivo cuando se agota toda la energía que tenía acumulada.

fr-FR.text: Il se prive de nourriture, résistant à la faim. On dit que son évolution commence lorsque ses réserves d’énergie sont épuisées.

it-IT.text: Resta a digiuno, sopportando la fame. Sembra che l’evoluzione si inneschi quando esaurisce l’energia accumulata.

pt-PT.text: Shelgon ignores its hunger entirely, never eating any food. Apparently, Shelgon will evolve once all its energy stores are used up.

zh-CN.text: 可以不吃食物忍受饥饿。据说当它用尽积蓄的能量后，就会开始进化。

de-DE.text: Brutalanda freut sich ungemein darüber, endlich fliegen zu können, doch wenn es wütend wird, gerät es außer Kontrolle.

en-US.text: While basking in the joy of flight generally keeps this Pokémon in high spirits, Salamence turns into an uncontrollable menace if something angers it.

es-ES.text: Feliz de ver cumplido su deseo, surca los cielos con buen ánimo, pero, si se enfada, se vuelve violento e incontrolable.

fr-FR.text: Heureux de pouvoir voler dans le ciel, il est souvent de bonne humeur, mais il devient incontrôlable lorsqu’on le met en colère.

it-IT.text: È generalmente di buon umore e traboccante di gioia per essere riuscito a volare, ma se si arrabbia diventa una furia incontrollabile.

pt-PT.text: While basking in the joy of flight generally keeps this Pokémon in high spirits, Salamence turns into an uncontrollable menace if something angers it.

zh-CN.text: 虽然在空中翱翔能够让它乐在其中，但是一旦被惹怒，就会大闹一番，不可收拾。

de-DE.text: Die Zellen seines Körpers bestehen aus Magneten. Anstelle von Blut fließt magnetische Energie durch Tanhel.

en-US.text: The cells in this Pokémon’s body are composed of magnetic material. Instead of blood, magnetic forces flow through Beldum’s body.

es-ES.text: Las células de su cuerpo están hechas de imanes. En lugar de sangre, una fuerza magnética recorre su cuerpo.

fr-FR.text: Les cellules de son corps sont composées d’aimants. Une force magnétique coule dans ses veines à la place du sang.

it-IT.text: Nel suo corpo, le cui cellule sono composte da calamite, scorre forza magnetica al posto del sangue.

pt-PT.text: The cells in this Pokémon’s body are composed of magnetic material. Instead of blood, magnetic forces flow through Beldum’s body.

zh-CN.text: 身体的细胞由磁铁构成。循环于全身的不是血液，而是磁力。

de-DE.text: Mithilfe von Magnetismus kann Metang fliegen. Auf der Jagd nach Beute manövriert es so mit hoher Geschwindigkeit durch schroffes Gebirge.

en-US.text: Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémon flies at high speeds, weaving through harsh mountain terrain in pursuit of prey.

es-ES.text: Levita gracias al magnetismo. Es capaz de sortear escarpadas montañas mientras vuela a altas velocidades en pos de su presa.

fr-FR.text: Ce Pokémon vole par magnétisme. Il poursuit ses proies en slalomant à toute allure entre les pics escarpés.

it-IT.text: Levita sfruttando la forza magnetica. Si fa strada fra i picchi scoscesi volando a grande velocità mentre insegue le prede.

pt-PT.text: Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémon flies at high speeds, weaving through harsh mountain terrain in pursuit of prey.

zh-CN.text: 依靠磁力飞行。能够在空中以高速穿过险峻的山岳，让追捕的猎物无处可逃。

de-DE.text: Dieses Pokémon entstand aus der Fusion zweier Metang. Es bezwingt Gegner mithilfe seiner Intelligenz, die der eines Supercomputers gleicht.

en-US.text: Metagross is the result of the fusion of two Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents through use of its supercomputer-level brain.

es-ES.text: Formado a partir de la unión de dos Metang. Emplea su inteligencia, comparable a la de un superordenador, para derrotar a sus rivales.

fr-FR.text: Né de la fusion de deux Métang, il vient à bout de ses ennemis grâce à son cerveau qui est aussi performant qu’un superordinateur.

it-IT.text: È il risultato della fusione di due Metang. Per sconfiggere i nemici si serve del suo cervello, equiparabile a un supercomputer.

pt-PT.text: Metagross is the result of the fusion of two Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents through use of its supercomputer-level brain.

zh-CN.text: ２只金属怪组合起来的样子。运用堪比超级计算机的头脑打败敌人。

de-DE.text: Selbst mit modernster Technologie konnten bei der Analyse seines Steinkörpers weder Herz noch Gehirn gefunden werden.

en-US.text: Cutting-edge technology was used to study the internals of this Pokémon’s rock body, but nothing was found—not even a brain or a heart.

es-ES.text: Su cuerpo rocoso ha sido examinado con las técnicas científicas más avanzadas, pero no se han encontrado ni su cerebro ni su corazón.

fr-FR.text: Bien que son corps de pierre ait été examiné avec les technologies les plus modernes, nulle trace de cerveau ou de cœur n’a été trouvée.

it-IT.text: Il suo corpo roccioso è stato analizzato usando le più moderne tecnologie, ma non si è trovata traccia di organi come cervello o cuore.

pt-PT.text: Cutting-edge technology was used to study the internals of this Pokémon’s rock body, but nothing was found—not even a brain or a heart.

zh-CN.text: 人们通过最新的科学技术对它的岩石身体做了调查，但是并未发现大脑和心脏。

de-DE.text: Sein gesamter Körper besteht aus Eis. Man sagt, es wurde während der Eiszeit unter einer dicken Eisschicht geboren.

en-US.text: This Pokémon’s body is made of solid ice. It’s said that Regice was born beneath thick ice in the ice age.

es-ES.text: Todo su cuerpo está compuesto de hielo. Se dice que surgió bajo una gruesa placa de hielo durante alguna glaciación.

fr-FR.text: Ce Pokémon de l’ère glaciaire dont le corps est entièrement composé d’eau gelée serait né sous une épaisse couche de glace.

it-IT.text: Il suo corpo è interamente costituito da ghiaccio. Si narra che nacque sotto un massiccio strato di ghiaccio durante l’era glaciale.

pt-PT.text: This Pokémon’s body is made of solid ice. It’s said that Regice was born beneath thick ice in the ice age.

zh-CN.text: 拥有一副由冰构成的身体。据说是诞生于冰河时期冻得厚厚实实的冰块之下。

de-DE.text: Gerüchten zufolge wurde dieses Pokémon tief im Mantel des Planeten geboren und kam vor etwa 10 000 Jahren an die Oberfläche.

en-US.text: It’s rumored that this Pokémon was born deep underground in the planet’s mantle and that it emerged onto the surface 10,000 years ago.

es-ES.text: Dicen que se formó en el manto terrestre y ascendió a la superficie hace aproximadamente diez mil años.

fr-FR.text: Il paraît qu’il est né dans le manteau terrestre et qu’il en a émergé il y a environ 10 000 ans.

it-IT.text: Si dice che sia nato nel mantello terrestre e che sia salito in superficie circa 10.000 anni fa.

pt-PT.text: It’s rumored that this Pokémon was born deep underground in the planet’s mantle and that it emerged onto the surface 10,000 years ago.

zh-CN.text: 据说诞生于地幔之中，在距今约１万年前现身于地面之上。

de-DE.text: Latias ist sehr intelligent und kann die menschliche Sprache verstehen. Es ist mit gläsernen Daunen bedeckt. Dieses Pokémon umhüllt seinen Körper mit den Daunen und kann Licht brechen, um seine Gestalt zu verändern.

en-US.text: Latias is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. It is covered with a glass-like down. The Pokémon enfolds its body with its down and refracts light to alter its appearance.

es-ES.text: Latias tiene un nivel de inteligencia tan alto que es capaz de entender el lenguaje humano. Este Pokémon usa el plumón cristalizado del que está cubierto como peto para refractar la luz y cambiar de aspecto.

fr-FR.text: Latias est très intelligent et comprend le langage des hommes. Il est recouvert d’une espèce de duvet ressemblant à du verre. Ce Pokémon s’enveloppe dans ce duvet et reflète la lumière pour changer son apparence.

it-IT.text: Estremamente intelligente, Latias è in grado di capire il linguaggio umano. Il suo corpo è ricoperto di piumino vetroso che usa per rifrangere la luce e mutare il proprio aspetto.

pt-PT.text: Latias is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. It is covered with a glass-like down. The Pokémon enfolds its body with its down and refracts light to alter its appearance.

zh-CN.text: 能非常敏锐地感知人心。一旦察觉到敌意，就会竖起全身羽毛，用激烈的叫声威吓对方。

de-DE.text: Latios schüttet nur seinem Trainer gegenüber sein Herz aus. Dieses Pokémon fliegt schneller als ein Flugzeug, indem es seine Vorderbeine einklappt, um den Luftwiderstand zu verringern.

en-US.text: Latios will only open its heart to a Trainer with a compassionate spirit. This Pokémon can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.

es-ES.text: Latios solo le abre el corazón a los Entrenadores compasivos. A la hora de volar, este Pokémon pliega las patas delanteras para minimizar la resistencia al aire y supera en velocidad a un avión a reacción.

fr-FR.text: Latios n’ouvrira son cœur qu’à un Dresseur doté d’un esprit compatissant. Ce Pokémon peut voler plus vite qu’un avion à réaction en repliant ses pattes avant pour améliorer son aérodynamisme.

it-IT.text: Latios apre il proprio cuore ad Allenatori d’animo buono e generoso. Il Pokémon riesce a volare più veloce di un aereo a reazione, piegando le zampe anteriori per minimizzare l’attrito dell’aria.

pt-PT.text: Latios will only open its heart to a Trainer with a compassionate spirit. This Pokémon can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.

zh-CN.text: 拥有将所见所思用影像展现给对方的能力。能理解人类的语言。

de-DE.text: Es heißt, Kyogre sei die Personifizierung des Meeres. Legenden zufolge hat es in seinem Bestreben, sich die Naturenergie anzueignen, viele Male gegen Groudon gekämpft.

en-US.text: Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

es-ES.text: A Kyogre siempre se le ha descrito como el Pokémon que expandió los océanos. Varias leyendas cuentan que libró combates contra Groudon en repetidas ocasiones para tener el control de la energía de la naturaleza.

fr-FR.text: Un Pokémon considéré comme l’avatar des océans. Selon les légendes, il a disputé de nombreux combats avec Groudon pour contrôler l’énergie de la nature.

it-IT.text: Si dice che questo Pokémon abbia un profondo legame con le distese dei mari. Le leggende narrano dei suoi continui scontri con Groudon per ottenere l’energia della natura.

pt-PT.text: Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

zh-CN.text: 通过自然的能量进行原始回归，恢复原本的样子。其力量可以呼风唤雨扩张海洋。

de-DE.text: Mithilfe von Naturenergie kann es eine Protomorphose durchführen und so seine ursprüngliche Form zurückerlangen. Dadurch kann es Magma hervorbringen und die Landmasse vergrößern.

en-US.text: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can cause magma to erupt and expand the landmass of the world.

es-ES.text: Groudon se sirve de la energía de la naturaleza para realizar su Regresión Primigenia y recobrar su apariencia primitiva. Con tal poder, puede crear magma para expandir los continentes.

fr-FR.text: Grâce à l’énergie de la nature, il peut accomplir sa Primo-Résurgence pour retrouver son apparence originelle. Ce pouvoir lui permet de créer du magma pour étendre les continents.

it-IT.text: L’energia della natura può causare l’archeorisveglio di questo Pokémon, facendolo tornare al suo aspetto originario. Può produrre fiumi di magma in grado di espandere le terre emerse.

pt-PT.text: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can cause magma to erupt and expand the landmass of the world.

zh-CN.text: 该宝可梦据说是大地的化身。传说，为了寻求自然的能量，它曾不断与盖欧卡争斗。

de-DE.text: Es fliegt durch die Ozonschicht und ernährt sich von Meteoren. Mithilfe der Energie, die durch diese Meteore in seinen Körper gelangt, kann es eine Mega-Entwicklung durchführen.

en-US.text: It flies forever through the ozone layer, consuming meteoroids for sustenance. The many meteoroids in its body provide the energy it needs to Mega Evolve.

es-ES.text: Rayquaza ha vivido en la capa de ozono durante millones de años, alimentándose de meteoritos. La energía de estos meteoritos se acumula en su cuerpo y le permite megaevolucionar.

fr-FR.text: Un Pokémon qui vit dans la couche d’ozone et se nourrit des météorites qu’il intercepte. Leur énergie s’accumule dans son corps, ce qui lui permet de méga-évoluer.

it-IT.text: Risiede nello strato di ozono, dove si nutre di meteoriti. Grazie alla loro energia che si accumula all’interno del suo corpo, può megaevolversi.

pt-PT.text: It flies forever through the ozone layer, consuming meteoroids for sustenance. The many meteoroids in its body provide the energy it needs to Mega Evolve.

zh-CN.text: 据说已经生存了数亿年。世间流传着其调解固拉多与盖欧卡之间争斗的传说。

de-DE.text: Es heißt, wenn es aus seinem tausendjährigen Schlaf erwacht, erfüllt es die Wünsche, die auf die Zettel an seinem Kopf geschrieben wurden.

en-US.text: It’s believed that when this Pokémon wakes from its 1,000-year slumber, it will grant any wishes written on the notes attached to its head.

es-ES.text: Se dice que concederá los deseos escritos en las notas de su cabeza cuando se despierte de su sueño milenario.

fr-FR.text: On raconte que lorsqu’il se réveille de son sommeil millénaire, il exauce les vœux écrits sur les rubans de papier de sa tête.

it-IT.text: Si dice che, al risveglio dal suo sonno millenario, realizzi i desideri scritti sui bigliettini attaccati alla sua testa.

pt-PT.text: It’s believed that when this Pokémon wakes from its 1,000-year slumber, it will grant any wishes written on the notes attached to its head.

zh-CN.text: 传说当它从１０００年的沉睡中醒来时，会实现写在它头部许愿笺上的愿望。

de-DE.text: Deoxys ging aus einem Virus aus dem Weltraum hervor. Es ist sehr intelligent und nutzt psychokinetische Energie. Dieses Pokémon verschießt Laserstrahlen aus einem kristallartigen Organ auf seinem Brustkorb.

en-US.text: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

es-ES.text: Deoxys surgió a partir de un virus espacial. Tiene un alto nivel intelectual y poderes psicoquinéticos. Este Pokémon dispara rayos láser por el órgano cristalino que tiene en el torso.

fr-FR.text: Deoxys était à l’origine un virus provenant de l’espace. Il est extrêmement intelligent et dispose de pouvoirs télékinétiques. Ce Pokémon envoie des lasers avec l’organe cristallin situé sur sa poitrine.

it-IT.text: Deoxys è nato da un virus proveniente dallo spazio. È dotato di estrema intelligenza e di poteri psicocinetici. Spara raggi laser dall’organo cristallino del proprio corpo.

pt-PT.text: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

zh-CN.text: 它是宇宙病毒的ＤＮＡ受到激光照射后，发生突变而生成的宝可梦。胸部的水晶体好像是它的大脑。

pt-PT.text: This remarkable, large-bodied Pokémon would serve beautifully as borrowed scenery for a garden, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness in search of clean water.

pt-PT.text: They form remarkably large flocks and are constantly fighting amongst themselves. I suspect that those with magnificent plumes on their heads are the strong ones.

pt-PT.text: It has left the flock, having gained strength enough to survive on its own. The astounding force with which Staraptor flies through the air allows it to carry away large, burly targets.

pt-PT.text: Its tears elicit sympathy from those who see them, but do not be deceived! This expulsion of body water is merely a physiological mechanism for keeping itself in good health.

zh-CN.text: 栖息在空气干燥岩石裸露的地方。空气越是干燥，它身上的绿球就越是会泛出暗淡的光泽。

de-DE.text: Es folgt dem talentierten Tänzer Pantifrost wie ein Schüler und imitiert seine Schritte.

en-US.text: Known to turn up in bustling marketplaces now and again. It mimics people much as a child would, then watches how they react, eyes sparkling.

es-ES.text: Su admiración por Mr. Rime, un consumado danzarín, lo lleva a seguirlo para aprender de él e imitar con esmero sus pasos de baile.

fr-FR.text: Il considère les meilleurs danseurs parmi les M. Glaquette comme ses maîtres et s’évertue à mimer leurs mouvements.

it-IT.text: Considera Mr. Rime il proprio maestro per le sue doti di ballerino, e ne imita diligentemente i passi di danza.

pt-PT.text: Known to turn up in bustling marketplaces now and again. It mimics people much as a child would, then watches how they react, eyes sparkling.

zh-CN.text: 像徒弟一样跟随着擅长跳舞的踏冰人偶，拼命模仿它的舞步。

de-DE.text: Seinen kostbaren, runden Stein leiht Wonneira nur denjenigen, die es mag. Bekommt es diesen nicht zurück, tobt es und weint bitterlich.

en-US.text: In imitation of Chansey, it keeps a round stone tucked into its belly pouch and cherishes it dearly. It gets along well with children and will sometimes play house with them for fun.

es-ES.text: Les deja su preciada roca redonda a aquellos con los que se lleva bien. Si no se la devuelven, se echa a llorar, presa de una rabieta.

fr-FR.text: Il prête volontiers son caillou rond à ceux qu’il apprécie, mais éclate en sanglots et se met en colère si on ne le lui rend pas.

it-IT.text: Dà in prestito il suo amato sasso a chi considera suo amico, ma se non gli viene restituito piange e si scatena.

pt-PT.text: In imitation of Chansey, it keeps a round stone tucked into its belly pouch and cherishes it dearly. It gets along well with children and will sometimes play house with them for fun.

zh-CN.text: 会把自己珍贵的浑圆石头借给关系变得很要好的对象。如果不还给它，它便会大哭大闹。

de-DE.text: Es kann die menschliche Sprache nachahmen. Versammeln sie sich, bringen sich alle dasselbe bei.

en-US.text: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.

es-ES.text: Puede imitar el lenguaje humano. Si se juntan varios, todos aprenden las mismas palabras.

fr-FR.text: On peut lui enseigner quelques mots. S’il s’agit d’un groupe, ils retiendront les mêmes phrases.

it-IT.text: Può imparare il linguaggio umano. Se un gruppo si raduna, tutti imparano le stesse parole.

pt-PT.text: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.

zh-CN.text: 通过发出与对手相同的叫声，让对方深信自己是同伴，从而免受袭击。

de-DE.text: Aufgrund seiner ständigen Untaten wurde es von einem Reisenden mithilfe mysteriöser Künste an einen Spiritkern gebunden.

en-US.text: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.

es-ES.text: Un viajero utilizó un misterioso hechizo para unirlo a una Piedra Espíritu por sus constantes fechorías.

fr-FR.text: Pour punir son comportement déplorable, un voyageur a utilisé un mystérieux sortilège pour l’enchaîner à une Clé de Voûte.

it-IT.text: A causa del suo comportamento molesto, è stato imprigionato in una Roccianima da un viandante tramite un incantesimo misterioso.

pt-PT.text: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.

zh-CN.text: 总是作恶多端，于是被使用神奇法术的旅人绑缚在楔石里。

de-DE.text: Es greift alles an, was sich bewegt, und zerrt es in sein Versteck. Kaumalat verfügt zwar über ein großes Maul, aber sein Magen ist relativ klein.

en-US.text: It nests in caves untouched by sunlight. Its sharp teeth may fall out when worn away or after an impact, but they regrow within a few days.

es-ES.text: Ataca indiscriminadamente a cualquier cosa que se mueva y la arrastra a su agujero. Pese a tener una boca enorme, su estómago es pequeño.

fr-FR.text: Il attaque et entraîne dans son antre tout ce qui bouge, sans distinction. Sa gueule est immense, mais son estomac est relativement petit.

it-IT.text: Attacca indiscriminatamente qualunque cosa si muova, per poi trascinarla nella tana. La bocca ha dimensioni notevoli ma lo stomaco è piccolo.

pt-PT.text: It nests in caves untouched by sunlight. Its sharp teeth may fall out when worn away or after an impact, but they regrow within a few days.

zh-CN.text: 遇到会动的东西就会扑上去将其拉回到自己住的横洞内。虽然嘴很大，但胃口却比较小。

de-DE.text: In der Höhle, die Knarksel als Nest dient, vergräbt es Edelsteine. Wer sie betritt, wird sofort von seinen Krallen und Zähnen zerfetzt.

en-US.text: Though Gabite are usually of a violent disposition, when I gave one a glass bead it had been eyeing covetously, it suddenly became quite docile.

es-ES.text: Entierra gemas en la cueva que le sirve de nido y hace trizas con sus garras y colmillos a cualquier intruso.

fr-FR.text: Il cache des pierres précieuses dans le sol de sa grotte, et accueille à coups de griffes et de crocs quiconque ose y pénétrer.

it-IT.text: Accumula pietre preziose nella grotta in cui vive. Fa a pezzi con gli artigli e le zanne chiunque vi si intrufoli.

pt-PT.text: Though Gabite are usually of a violent disposition, when I gave one a glass bead it had been eyeing covetously, it suddenly became quite docile.

zh-CN.text: 会把宝石埋藏在栖息的洞窟内。入侵者闯入洞窟后，会立刻被它用爪子和牙齿撕碎。

de-DE.text: Auch am Boden bewegt es sich schnell. Es kann im verschneiten Gebirge Beute erlegen und in sein Nest bringen, bevor sein Körper auskühlt.

en-US.text: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.

es-ES.text: Se mueve a gran velocidad incluso por tierra. Es capaz de cazar una presa en una montaña nevada y volver a su guarida sin llegar a pasar frío.

fr-FR.text: Ce Pokémon très rapide même au sol capture ses proies sur les monts enneigés et rentre vite dans son antre avant que son corps ne gèle.

it-IT.text: È veloce anche a terra. È in grado di abbattere le prede tra le montagne innevate e tornare nella sua tana prima di congelarsi.

pt-PT.text: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.

zh-CN.text: 身手在陆地上也很矫捷，在雪山上会赶在身体冻僵前干掉猎物并返回住处。

de-DE.text: Es hortet Nahrung unter seinem Fell. Vertraut es jemandem, gibt es ihm manchmal einen kleinen Happen ab, aber nicht mehr.

en-US.text: Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. It pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.

es-ES.text: Guarda alimentos bajo el pelaje. Compartirá un pequeño bocado de vez en cuando con quien logre ganarse su confianza.

fr-FR.text: Il conserve sa nourriture sous son épaisse fourrure. Il lui arrive d’en offrir un peu à ceux en qui il a confiance.

it-IT.text: Conserva il cibo sotto la pelliccia e talvolta ne condivide un boccone con chi si è guadagnato la sua piena fiducia.

pt-PT.text: Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. It pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.

zh-CN.text: 在体毛下面储存食物。如果是自己信赖的对象，也会把食物分给对方一口。

de-DE.text: Es erspürt nicht nur die Gefühle anderer, sondern auch den Zustand der Natur durch Wellen, die Aura genannt werden.

en-US.text: Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu's approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.

es-ES.text: Percibe los sentimientos de quienes lo rodean, así como las condiciones del entorno, mediante unas ondas conocidas como auras.

fr-FR.text: Il perçoit sous forme d’aura non seulement les sentiments des autres, mais aussi l’état de la nature.

it-IT.text: Percepisce non solo le emozioni degli altri, ma anche le condizioni dell’ambiente naturale sotto forma di onde definite “aura”.

pt-PT.text: Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu's approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.

zh-CN.text: 除了能读懂对手的感情，也能以“波导”这种形式的波来观察大自然的样子。

de-DE.text: Es kann die Gedanken von Menschen lesen. Deshalb lässt es sich nur auf Trainer ein, die ihr Herz auf dem rechten Fleck haben.

en-US.text: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.

es-ES.text: Puede leer los pensamientos de la gente, por lo que establece lazos afectivos únicamente con Entrenadores de corazón noble.

fr-FR.text: Étant capable de lire ce que pensent les humains, ce Pokémon ne s’attache qu’aux Dresseurs dotés d’un cœur pur.

it-IT.text: È in grado di comprendere anche i pensieri degli esseri umani. Per questo, si affeziona solo agli Allenatori dall’animo onesto.

pt-PT.text: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.

zh-CN.text: 他能理解人类的想法，因此只会去亲近内心端正的训练家。

de-DE.text: Es ist hauptsächlich tagsüber aktiv. Die Nächte in der Wüste sind kalt, deswegen vergräbt es sich zum Schlafen tief im Sand.

en-US.text: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

es-ES.text: Este Pokémon de hábitos diurnos se entierra en la arena para dormir cuando la temperatura en el desierto se desploma al caer la noche.

fr-FR.text: Il est principalement actif pendant la journée. Il s’enfouit profondément dans le sable pour dormir, car les nuits désertiques sont très froides.

it-IT.text: È attivo principalmente di giorno. Dato che nel deserto la temperatura notturna è molto bassa, scava profonde buche nella sabbia per dormire.

pt-PT.text: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

zh-CN.text: 主要在白天活动。因为沙漠的夜晚会降温，所以会钻到沙子的深处睡觉。

de-DE.text: Wenn man es wütend macht, wird es rabiat. Es stößt aufgenommenen Sand aus und verursacht damit einen Sandsturm.

en-US.text: Short-tempered and easily moved to violence. It whips up whirlwinds of sand to crush its foes' spirits, then goes in for the attack.

es-ES.text: Puede ser muy agresivo cuando se enfada. Provoca auténticas tempestades de arena al expeler la que ha tragado.

fr-FR.text: Il entre dans une violente colère quand on l’énerve : il expulse le sable qu’il a accumulé pour provoquer de véritables tempêtes.

it-IT.text: Quando si arrabbia diventa molto violento ed espelle la sabbia che ha immagazzinato provocando tempeste di sabbia.

pt-PT.text: Short-tempered and easily moved to violence. It whips up whirlwinds of sand to crush its foes' spirits, then goes in for the attack.

zh-CN.text: 生气的时候非常凶暴。会喷出储存在体内的沙子来引发沙尘暴。

de-DE.text: Es schlägt mit den giftigen Krallen an seinem Schweif zu. Wer von ihnen gestochen wird, bekommt ein lähmendes Gift injiziert.

en-US.text: Its claws are not only razor-sharp but poisonous, making Skorupi a highly dangerous Pokémon. It seems to be weakened by cold temperatures, however.

es-ES.text: Ataca con las pinzas venenosas de la cola. Tras clavarlas, inyecta una toxina que inmoviliza a la presa.

fr-FR.text: Il attaque avec les pinces empoisonnées de sa queue. Le venin se répand alors dans le corps de la victime et la paralyse.

it-IT.text: Attacca la preda afferrandola con gli artigli velenosi della coda, poi inietta il veleno per immobilizzarla.

pt-PT.text: Its claws are not only razor-sharp but poisonous, making Skorupi a highly dangerous Pokémon. It seems to be weakened by cold temperatures, however.

zh-CN.text: 用尾巴上带毒的钩爪袭击对手。一旦被夹住，毒素就会扩散开来，导致全身无法动弹。

de-DE.text: Es wird auch „Wüstendämon“ genannt, weil es so grausam ist. Nur mit Hippoterus legt es sich nie an, sondern verhält sich ruhig.

en-US.text: Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.

es-ES.text: Su ferocidad le ha granjeado el sobrenombre del Diablo de la Arena, pero en presencia de los Hippowdon se muestra dócil y pacífico.

fr-FR.text: Sa férocité lui a valu le surnom de « démon du désert », mais face à un Hippodocus, il est parfaitement docile et évite de le provoquer.

it-IT.text: È chiamato “demone della sabbia” per via della sua ferocia, ma in presenza di Hippowdon se ne sta tranquillo ed evita di provocarlo.

pt-PT.text: Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.

zh-CN.text: 虽然狰狞凶猛到被人们称为沙之恶魔，但在河马兽面前却表现得低调温顺。

de-DE.text: Verdünnt man sein Gift, wird es zu Medizin. Seit es zum Maskottchen eines Pharmakonzerns wurde, hat es viele neue Fans gewonnen.

en-US.text: A poison wielder with a dastardly personality. Despite such qualities, this species is afforded a measure of popularity due to its peculiar cry and comical features.

es-ES.text: Su veneno posee propiedades medicinales si se diluye. Se ha vuelto muy popular desde que una empresa farmacéutica lo adoptó como mascota.

fr-FR.text: Dilué, son poison sert de remède. Cela lui a valu de devenir la mascotte populaire d’une entreprise de produits pharmaceutiques.

it-IT.text: Se diluito, il suo veleno ha proprietà medicinali. È diventato popolare da quando una casa farmaceutica ne ha fatto la sua mascotte.

pt-PT.text: A poison wielder with a dastardly personality. Despite such qualities, this species is afforded a measure of popularity due to its peculiar cry and comical features.

zh-CN.text: 毒素在稀释后能制成药品。它是制药公司的吉祥物，广受众人的欢迎。

de-DE.text: Wenn es seine Beute erlegt, quakt es seinen Triumph in die Welt hinaus. Es ist artverwandt mit Branawarz.

en-US.text: Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.

es-ES.text: Cuando abate una presa, emite un croar de victoria a pleno pulmón. Está emparentado con los Seismitoad.

fr-FR.text: Il lance un coassement viril de victoire quand il parvient à terrasser sa proie. Il s’apparente aux Crapustule.

it-IT.text: Quando abbatte la preda, lancia un alto gracidio di vittoria. Come specie è affine ai Seismitoad.

pt-PT.text: Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.

zh-CN.text: 制服了猎物之后，便会呱呱地发出胜利的欢呼。与蟾蜍王是相近的物种。

de-DE.text: Klammert sich an Bäume in Sümpfen. Lockt Beute mit seinem süßlichen Speichel an und schluckt sie dann.

en-US.text: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.

es-ES.text: Se cuelga de los árboles en los pantanos. Atrae a sus presas con su dulce olor y las engulle.

fr-FR.text: Il s’accroche aux arbres des marais et attire ses proies avec sa salive à l’odeur enivrante.

it-IT.text: Si attacca agli alberi nelle paludi. Attrae le prede con il dolce aroma della saliva e poi le ingoia.

pt-PT.text: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.

zh-CN.text: 先用甜香的唾液引诱猎物，然后用大颚大口地嚼。要花１整天吃掉猎物。

de-DE.text: Seine leuchtenden Flossen locken Beute an. Bei Tag bleibt es nahe an der Wasseroberfläche, während es abends in den Tiefen verschwindet.

en-US.text: What a gorgeous sight this Pokémon is as it swims with its long, pink-painted caudal fins fluttering behind it. Finneon's beautiful appearance has led to its nickname: ”finery fish.”

es-ES.text: Por el día permanece cerca de la superficie y se retira a las profundidades por la noche. Atrae a las presas con sus brillantes aletas caudales.

fr-FR.text: Il attire ses proies avec ses nageoires caudales lumineuses. Il passe la journée à la surface et se retire dans les abysses la nuit venue.

it-IT.text: Attira la preda con le sue brillanti pinne. Di giorno nuota vicino alla superficie del mare, mentre di notte si sposta in profondità.

pt-PT.text: What a gorgeous sight this Pokémon is as it swims with its long, pink-painted caudal fins fluttering behind it. Finneon's beautiful appearance has led to its nickname: ”finery fish.”

zh-CN.text: 用发光的尾鳍引诱猎物。白天会在海面附近，到了夜里就向海的深处移动。

de-DE.text: Es bewegt sich krabbelnd über den Boden der Tiefsee. Seine prachtvollen Flossen leuchten wie der Sternenhimmel.

en-US.text: Uses its gleaming fins to hunt its prey. The view of Lumineon schooling near the surface of the sea at night is breathtaking— it's as though there were shining stars right there.

es-ES.text: Nada arrastrándose por el lecho marino. Sus espléndidas aletas brillan como las estrellas del firmamento.

fr-FR.text: Il se déplace en rampant dans les profondeurs de l’océan. Ses nageoires brillent telles des étoiles dans le ciel nocturne.

it-IT.text: Avanza strisciando sul fondo degli abissi marini. La luce meravigliosa delle sue pinne ricorda le stelle risplendenti del cielo notturno.

pt-PT.text: Uses its gleaming fins to hunt its prey. The view of Lumineon schooling near the surface of the sea at night is breathtaking— it's as though there were shining stars right there.

zh-CN.text: 像是爬行一样在深海的海底游泳。鳍上发出的充满幻想的光就像是夜空的星星。

de-DE.text: Es mischt sich unter Remoraid-Schwärme und schwimmt mit ihnen. Werden diese angegriffen, kämpft es gemeinsam an ihrer Seite.

en-US.text: Though ball-like in shape, this Pokémon is a proficient swimmer. I have discovered that if a Mantyke spends much time with schools of Remoraid, it will eventually achieve evolution.

es-ES.text: Nada con los bancos de Remoraid y lucha junto a ellos cuando los ataca un enemigo.

fr-FR.text: Il nage au sein des bancs de Rémoraid. Lorsqu’un prédateur les attaque, il se bat à leurs côtés.

it-IT.text: Nuota in mezzo ai banchi di Remoraid e lotta assieme a loro quando vengono attaccati.

pt-PT.text: Though ball-like in shape, this Pokémon is a proficient swimmer. I have discovered that if a Mantyke spends much time with schools of Remoraid, it will eventually achieve evolution.

zh-CN.text: 混在铁炮鱼的大群里游泳。受到敌人袭击的时候，会和铁炮鱼们并肩作战。

de-DE.text: Die an Speiseeis erinnernden Beeren, die an seinem Bauch wachsen, sind bei den Flampion Galars ein sehr beliebter Snack.

en-US.text: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.

es-ES.text: Las bayas con aspecto de helado que le crecen alrededor de la barriga son la comida favorita de los Darumaka que habitan en Galar.

fr-FR.text: Les Baies en forme de crèmes glacées qui poussent sur son ventre sont le mets favori des Darumarond vivant à Galar.

it-IT.text: Le bacche simili a ghiaccioli che gli crescono attorno al ventre sono il cibo preferito dei Darumaka che vivono a Galar.

pt-PT.text: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.

zh-CN.text: 雪笠怪肚子上结出来的口感好似冰棍的树果是伽勒尔的火红不倒翁们的最爱。

de-DE.text: Dieses Pokémon löst Blizzards aus. Wenn es seinen großen Körper schüttelt, wird in seiner Umgebung alles sofort schneeweiß.

en-US.text: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.

es-ES.text: Posee la capacidad de generar ventiscas. Si agita su enorme cuerpo, el terreno circundante queda inmediatamente cubierto de nieve.

fr-FR.text: Ce grand Pokémon déclenche des blizzards. Lorsqu’il agite son corps, tout ce qui l’entoure se retrouve couvert de neige.

it-IT.text: Scatena bufere di neve. Se scuote il suo grosso corpo, imbianca il terreno circostante in un attimo.

pt-PT.text: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.

zh-CN.text: 会引发暴风雪的宝可梦。只要它摇动巨大的身体，周围立刻会变得一片雪白。

de-DE.text: Sie kommunizieren miteinander, indem sie Zeichen mit ihren Krallen hinterlassen. Es soll über 500 davon geben.

en-US.text: This species corners prey as a pack, under the guidance of a leader. Weavile displays increased cunning, leading me to speculate that its evolution caused further brain development.

es-ES.text: Se comunican mediante marcas que tallan con sus garras. Se cree que tienen un repertorio de más de 500.

fr-FR.text: Il communique avec ses semblables en gravant des motifs avec ses griffes. Il existerait près de 500 signes différents.

it-IT.text: Comunica con i suoi simili tramite i segni che traccia con le unghie. Si dice che esistano più di 500 segni diversi.

pt-PT.text: This species corners prey as a pack, under the guidance of a leader. Weavile displays increased cunning, leading me to speculate that its evolution caused further brain development.

zh-CN.text: 通过用爪子留下记号来与伙伴联络。据说记号的种类有５００种以上。

de-DE.text: Man vermutet, es habe sich entwickelt, nachdem es einem besonderen Magnetfeld ausgesetzt war, das seine Molekularstruktur veränderte.

en-US.text: I theorize that a special magnetic field influenced this Pokémon, changing its molecular structure and causing it to evolve. It emits strange radio waves toward space from its antenna.

es-ES.text: Se piensa que estuvo expuesto a un campo magnético especial que alteró su estructura molecular e hizo que evolucionara.

fr-FR.text: On pense qu’il a évolué après avoir été exposé à un champ magnétique particulier qui a modifié la structure moléculaire de son corps.

it-IT.text: Si pensa che la sua struttura molecolare sia mutata in seguito all’esposizione a uno speciale campo magnetico, che ha innescato l’evoluzione.

pt-PT.text: I theorize that a special magnetic field influenced this Pokémon, changing its molecular structure and causing it to evolve. It emits strange radio waves toward space from its antenna.

zh-CN.text: 人们认为，它是因为受到特殊磁场的影响，身体的分子构造发生了变化，才进化成这样的。

de-DE.text: Mit seiner Zunge kann es alles tun und ist damit so geschickt wie Menschen mit ihren Händen. Diese verwendet Schlurplek nur sehr unbeholfen.

en-US.text: Its tongue can extend and contract freely, and it is capable of reaching lengths over 10 times Lickilicky's height. Beware of the saliva, as it contains corrosive elements.

es-ES.text: Es tan diestro con la lengua como un ser humano con las manos. Por el contrario, muestra escasa maña con los dedos.

it-IT.text: Può fare qualsiasi cosa con la sua lingua, agile quanto le mani di un essere umano. In compenso, è maldestro nell’uso delle dita.

pt-PT.text: Its tongue can extend and contract freely, and it is capable of reaching lengths over 10 times Lickilicky's height. Beware of the saliva, as it contains corrosive elements.

en-US.text: This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.

it-IT.text: Respinge gli attacchi con la sua Copertura e approfitta del momento di esitazione dell’avversario per perforarlo con il suo trapano.

pt-PT.text: This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.

zh-CN.text: 用护具弹开敌人的攻击，在对手畏缩时用自己引以为傲的钻头贯穿对方。

de-DE.text: Je wärmer sein Lebensraum ist, desto schneller wachsen seine Ranken. Werden sie zu lang, kürzt Tangoloss sie, indem es sie abreißt.

en-US.text: Draped with long vines, it resembles a shrub in appearance. It swings bundles of vines as though they were arms, wrapping them around prey to ensnare them.

es-ES.text: Las lianas le crecen más rápidamente si vive en regiones cálidas. Cuando alcanzan cierta longitud, se las corta.

fr-FR.text: Ses lianes poussent plus rapidement s’il vit sous un climat chaud. Quand elles deviennent trop longues, il se les coupe.

it-IT.text: Più il territorio in cui vive è caldo, più le sue liane crescono velocemente. Quando si allungano troppo, le taglia per accorciarle.

pt-PT.text: Draped with long vines, it resembles a shrub in appearance. It swings bundles of vines as though they were arms, wrapping them around prey to ensnare them.

de-DE.text: Elevoltek gehört zu jenen Elektro-Pokémon, die den meisten Strom erzeugen können. Mit seinen Schweifspitzen entlädt es Starkstrom.

en-US.text: Its evolution was induced by an unusual item, and its electrical output rises along with its heart rate. From its tails, it can unleash an electric current measuring 20,000 volts.

es-ES.text: Es de los Pokémon de tipo Eléctrico que más electricidad producen. Genera una corriente de alta tensión desde las puntas de las colas.

fr-FR.text: La quantité d’électricité qu’il génère est énorme, même pour un Pokémon Électrik. Il inflige de fortes décharges du bout de ses queues.

it-IT.text: È uno dei Pokémon di tipo Elettro che producono più elettricità. Rilascia scariche ad alto voltaggio dalla punta delle code.

pt-PT.text: Its evolution was induced by an unusual item, and its electrical output rises along with its heart rate. From its tails, it can unleash an electric current measuring 20,000 volts.

zh-CN.text: 发电量在电气宝可梦当中属于最高级别。可以从尾巴尖端释放高压电流。

de-DE.text: Durch das Leben in Vulkankratern ähnelt Magbrants Körper seinem Umfeld. Es besitzt ein Organ, das einer Magmakammer gleicht.

en-US.text: Use of a strange item caused this Pokémon to evolve. Fireballs launched from the ends of its tubelike arms are hot enough to melt an iron pot in an instant.

es-ES.text: Al vivir en un cráter, su cuerpo ha adquirido un aspecto similar al de un volcán y ha desarrollado un órgano parecido a una cámara magmática.

fr-FR.text: Au fil du temps, son corps est devenu similaire à un volcan, et un de ses organes ressemble désormais à une chambre magmatique.

it-IT.text: Vivendo nei crateri il suo corpo è diventato simile a un vulcano, sviluppando un organo analogo a una camera magmatica.

pt-PT.text: Use of a strange item caused this Pokémon to evolve. Fireballs launched from the ends of its tubelike arms are hot enough to melt an iron pot in an instant.

zh-CN.text: 由于栖息在火山口，因此身体逐渐变得像火山一样，还长着类似岩浆库的器官。

de-DE.text: Man sagt, es verteile Wohltaten. Aus diesem Grund wird sein Abbild seit Urzeiten für Glücksbringer verwendet.

en-US.text: Scant few have ever sighted this Pokémon. After studying what literature remains, I am certain Togekiss will reveal itself when peace reigns in the land.

es-ES.text: Se dice que es portador de buena suerte. Por ello, su imagen aparece representada en talismanes y amuletos desde la antigüedad.

fr-FR.text: On dit que ce Pokémon dispense ses bienfaits, ce qui explique pourquoi il est représenté sur les porte-bonheurs depuis fort longtemps.

it-IT.text: Si dice che doni prosperità, e per questo viene rappresentato nei portafortuna fin dall’antichità.

pt-PT.text: Scant few have ever sighted this Pokémon. After studying what literature remains, I am certain Togekiss will reveal itself when peace reigns in the land.

zh-CN.text: 被称为会带来恩惠的宝可梦，从很久很久以前开始，人们就视它为吉祥之物。

de-DE.text: Es kann mühelos einen Erwachsenen umhertragen. Die Federn an seinem Hinterteil stabilisieren seinen Flug.

en-US.text: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.

es-ES.text: Con sus seis patas puede llevar a un adulto y volar con comodidad. Se equilibra con las alas de su cola.

fr-FR.text: Il peut voler avec aise tout en portant un adulte dans ses six pattes. Les ailes de sa queue lui servent de balancier.

it-IT.text: Riesce a volare comodamente anche trasportando un adulto con le sue sei zampe. Si bilancia con la coda.

pt-PT.text: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.

de-DE.text: Sein Schweif ist scharf wie eine Klinge. Es ist stolz darauf, dass es damit selbst einen großen Baum sauber zweiteilen kann.

en-US.text: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.

es-ES.text: Se siente muy orgulloso de su cola afilada como una espada, con la que es capaz de cortar en dos el tronco de un árbol grueso.

fr-FR.text: Grâce à sa queue aussi effilée qu’une lame, il est capable de fendre en deux des arbres immenses.

it-IT.text: Va molto fiero della sua coda affilata come una lama, con cui può tranciare in due persino un grosso albero.

pt-PT.text: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.

zh-CN.text: 尾巴好似锐利的刀刃，锋利得无与伦比，连大树都能一斩为二。

en-US.text: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

es-ES.text: El aire gélido que exhala crea una suerte de cristales de hielo que lo hace muy demandado en las estaciones de esquí.

fr-FR.text: Ce Pokémon exhale un vent glacial qui crée une neige poudreuse. Sa présence est très appréciée dans les stations de ski.

it-IT.text: L’aria gelida emessa da Glaceon genera una neve molto sottile, perfetta per le piste da sci.

pt-PT.text: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

de-DE.text: Es fliegt völlig lautlos. Erst fängt es seine Beute mit seinem langen Schweif, dann saugt es sie aus.

en-US.text: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.

es-ES.text: Vuela sin hacer nada de ruido. Con su larga cola captura a sus presas y las muerde con sus colmillos.

fr-FR.text: Il vole sans un bruit, et capture ses proies avec sa queue pour leur infliger une morsure critique.

it-IT.text: Vola senza far rumore. Afferra le prede con la lunga coda e perfora il loro punto vitale con i canini.

pt-PT.text: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.

es-ES.text: Es tan fuerte como parece. Cuanto más frío hace, más gruesos, largos e imponentes se vuelven sus colmillos de hielo.

fr-FR.text: Comme son physique le laisse deviner, il est très fort. La taille de ses défenses de glace augmente à mesure que la température baisse.

it-IT.text: È forte, proprio come il suo aspetto lascia intendere. Più freddo fa, più spesse e lunghe diventano le sue zanne di ghiaccio.

pt-PT.text: This species reached its zenith during the period known as the ice age. I suspect that Hisui's frigid climate is in harmony with Mamoswine's constitution, thus awakening hidden potential.

it-IT.text: Pare che si sia evoluto in seguito all’installazione di un programma, ma la comunità scientifica non è concorde nel definire ciò un’evoluzione.

pt-PT.text: A curious item induced this evolution. The Pokémon's offensive capabilities have greatly increased, but the strangeness of its behavior has magnified in equal measure. This worries me.

en-US.text: The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.

fr-FR.text: Ses sens aiguisés lui indiquent lorsque quelqu’un est en danger. Il accourt alors à la rescousse.

it-IT.text: È in grado di captare con estrema sensibilità lo stato d’animo di chi si trova nei guai e può così accorrere subito in suo aiuto.

pt-PT.text: The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.

pt-PT.text: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.

es-ES.text: Si alguien se duerme con una pluma suya, tendrá sueños maravillosos. Encarna el creciente lunar.

fr-FR.text: Dormir avec une de ses plumes à la main permet de faire de beaux rêves. On le surnomme « avatar du croissant de lune ».

it-IT.text: Se si dorme con piume di Cresselia, si faranno bei sogni. È l’incarnazione di uno spicchio di luna.

pt-PT.text: Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.

zh-CN.text: 飞行的时候，会从薄纱一样的翅膀中发出闪光粒子。被称为新月的化身。

de-DE.text: Lässt sich in warmen Meeren treiben, kehrt aber immer an den Platz seiner Geburt zurück.

en-US.text: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.

es-ES.text: Va a la deriva por mares cálidos. Siempre vuelve a donde nació, por mucho que se haya alejado.

fr-FR.text: Ce Pokémon des mers chaudes revient toujours à son lieu de naissance, peu importe la distance.

it-IT.text: Si sposta nei mari caldi. Torna sempre dove è nato, anche se si trova molto lontano.

pt-PT.text: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.

zh-CN.text: 如果海水的温度上升，该宝可梦就会让头部的浮囊膨胀起来，然后集体在海面上漂浮。

de-DE.text: Es besitzt die wundersame Fähigkeit, das Herz eines jeden anderen Pokémon anzurühren.

en-US.text: Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui's coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione, it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.

es-ES.text: Posee un poder singular que hace que entable amistad con casi cualquier Pokémon.

fr-FR.text: Il possède l’étrange pouvoir de s’entendre avec n’importe quel Pokémon.

it-IT.text: Dispone di un potere innato che lo fa legare con qualsiasi specie di Pokémon.

pt-PT.text: Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui's coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione, it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.

zh-CN.text: 如果使用与生俱来的神奇力量，就可以和任何宝可梦心意相通。

de-DE.text: Es kann andere in Schlaf versetzen und ihnen Träume geben. Es ist nur bei Neumond aktiv.

en-US.text: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

es-ES.text: Puede adormecer a la gente y hacerles soñar. Está activo en las noches de luna nueva.

fr-FR.text: Il a la capacité de bercer les gens pour les faire rêver. Il se montre durant les nuits de nouvelle lune.

it-IT.text: Ha l’abilità di far addormentare la gente e farla sognare. È attivo nelle notti di luna nuova.

pt-PT.text: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

zh-CN.text: 用能引诱对方进入深度睡眠的力量，让人和宝可梦做恶梦，并将其驱逐出自己的领地。

de-DE.text: Es heißt, wenn die Gracidea blühen, drückt es seine Dankbarkeit aus, indem es hoch in die Lüfte fliegt.

en-US.text: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

es-ES.text: Se dice que, cuando florecen las Gracídeas, Shaymin alza el vuelo para mostrar su gratitud.

fr-FR.text: Il prend son essor pour répandre la gratitude lorsque les Gracidées fleurissent.

it-IT.text: Si narra che Shaymin si alzi in volo per esprimere commossa gratitudine per la fioritura delle gracidee.

pt-PT.text: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

zh-CN.text: 拥有分解大气中的毒素，让荒芜大地瞬间变成花圃的力量。

de-DE.text: Die Mythologie erzählt, dass dieses Pokémon geboren wurde, bevor das Universum überhaupt existierte.

en-US.text: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.

es-ES.text: La mitología cuenta que este Pokémon nació antes de que el Universo existiera.

fr-FR.text: Dans la mythologie, ce Pokémon existait déjà avant la formation de l’univers.

it-IT.text: Nei racconti mitologici si dice che questo Pokémon sia nato ancor prima dell’universo.

pt-PT.text: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.

zh-CN.text: 神奥神话里说，它从蛋中现身，并创造出了整个世界。

de-DE.text: Jeder, dem Victini seine grenzenlose Energie zuteilwerden lässt, strotzt nur so vor Kraft.

en-US.text: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.

es-ES.text: Cuando Victini comparte su energía ilimitada, esa persona o Pokémon irradia abundante poder.

fr-FR.text: L’énergie sans limites qu’il produit donne une force incroyable à ceux qui entrent en contact avec elle.

it-IT.text: Può condividere l’energia infinita che emana, donando un potere immenso a chi la riceve.

pt-PT.text: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.

zh-CN.text: 是会带来胜利的宝可梦。据说带着比克提尼的训练家会赢得任何对战。

de-DE.text: Fängt mit dem Schweif Sonnenlicht auf, um Photosynthese zu betreiben. Fehlt ihm die Kraft, hängt sein Schweif schlaff herab.

en-US.text: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

es-ES.text: Sintetiza la luz del sol que recoge con su cola. Esta se le queda abatida cuando le fallan las energías.

fr-FR.text: Il laisse sa queue prendre le soleil pour sa photosynthèse. Quand il est malade, sa queue pend tristement.

it-IT.text: Assorbe i raggi solari dalla coda per operare la fotosintesi. Quando non sta bene, la sua coda si affloscia.

pt-PT.text: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

zh-CN.text: 当尾巴的叶子受到日照制造出能量后，动作就会变得敏捷，招式也会更加强劲。

de-DE.text: Es achtet stets auf Reinlichkeit, da es mit schmutzigen Blättern keine Photosynthese betreiben kann.

en-US.text: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

es-ES.text: Cuando su cuerpo está sucio, no puede realizar la fotosíntesis con sus hojas, así que cuida mucho su higiene personal.

fr-FR.text: La saleté l’empêchant d’utiliser la photosynthèse, il prend grand soin d’être toujours propre.

it-IT.text: Se si sporca, le sue foglie non possono più effettuare la fotosintesi, perciò si tiene sempre molto pulito.

pt-PT.text: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

zh-CN.text: 会低下身子飞快穿过草丛，用藤鞭毫不留情地打垮对手。

de-DE.text: Bringt Gegner mit einem einzigen kühlen Blick zum Erstarren. In seinem Inneren verstärkt es die Energie der Sonne.

en-US.text: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

es-ES.text: Detiene los movimientos del rival con una sola mirada. Expande la energía solar dentro de su cuerpo.

fr-FR.text: Il peut paralyser l’ennemi d’un regard. Il amplifie l’énergie du soleil dans son corps.

it-IT.text: Può bloccare i movimenti dell’avversario con il solo sguardo. Amplifica l’energia solare all’interno del suo corpo.

pt-PT.text: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

zh-CN.text: 能将由阳光制造出的能量在长长的身体内增强至原本的数十倍。

de-DE.text: Floink liebt es, selbst geröstete Nüsse zu verspeisen. Ab und zu verkohlt es sie jedoch ungewollt vor lauter Vorfreude.

en-US.text: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

es-ES.text: Le encanta comer bayas tostadas, pero a veces se emociona demasiado y termina churruscándolas.

fr-FR.text: Il adore se goinfrer de Baies grillées, mais il lui arrive de les réduire en cendres dans son excitation.

it-IT.text: Adora mangiare le bacche arrostite, ma a volte si fa prendere la mano per l’eccitazione e le riduce in cenere.

pt-PT.text: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

zh-CN.text: 能以有别外表的轻巧动作玩弄敌人。可从左右两个鼻孔连续发射出火球。

de-DE.text: Lodert das Feuer in ihm auf, bewegt es sich geschmeidiger und schneller. Bei Gefahr lässt es ordentlich Dampf ab.

en-US.text: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

es-ES.text: Cuando las llamas de su interior se avivan, aumenta su velocidad y agilidad. Emite humo si está en peligro.

fr-FR.text: Quand le feu dans son corps s’embrase, sa vitesse et son agilité augmentent. En cas d’urgence, il crache de la fumée.

it-IT.text: Quando la fiamma interna arde intensa, diventa più rapido e scattante. Nei momenti critici esala fumo.

pt-PT.text: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

zh-CN.text: 战斗时会热血沸腾。体温会急速上升，然后变成灼热的火球。

de-DE.text: Es trägt einen Backenbart aus Feuer und beherrscht Kampftechniken, die ebenso wuchtig wie schnell sind.

en-US.text: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

es-ES.text: Posee una tupida barba fogosa. Es tanto rápido como poderoso, y su principal baza es la lucha cuerpo a cuerpo.

fr-FR.text: Il a une barbe enflammée. Il maîtrise des techniques de combat au corps à corps rapides et puissantes.

it-IT.text: La sua barba è avvolta dalle fiamme. Padroneggia mosse di lotta che combinano potenza e rapidità.

pt-PT.text: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

zh-CN.text: 在胸内熊熊燃烧的火焰从颚部猛烈地喷出，形成了火焰的胡须。

de-DE.text: Kämpft mit der Muschel auf seinem Bauch. Pariert es einen Angriff, schlägt es sofort mit einer Schnitt-Attacke zurück.

en-US.text: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

es-ES.text: Ataca con la vieira de su ombligo. En cuanto para un ataque, pasa al contraataque sin dilación.

fr-FR.text: Il combat avec le coupillage de son ventre. Il peut parer un assaut et immédiatement contre-attaquer.

it-IT.text: Combatte con la conchiglia che ha sul ventre. Contrattacca prontamente dopo aver parato l’attacco avversario.

pt-PT.text: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

zh-CN.text: 会把腹部的扇贝贝如同小刀般使用，接了敌人的招式后会立马切斩反击。

de-DE.text: Jedes Zwottronin eignet sich über strenges Training einen völlig eigenen Muschelkampfstil an.

en-US.text: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

es-ES.text: Tras un exhaustivo entrenamiento, Dewott puede dominar diversas técnicas para usar con sus vieiras.

fr-FR.text: Chaque Mateloutre a sa propre technique d’escrime au coupillage, acquise grâce à un entraînement drastique.

it-IT.text: Le loro conchiglie sono tutte diverse nella forma e ogni Dewott si allena duramente per imparare a usarle.

pt-PT.text: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

zh-CN.text: 它将２枚扇贝贝运用得行云流水的动作，据说被人们当作了剑术的范本。

de-DE.text: Besiegt Gegner durch einen einzigen Hieb mit der Klinge an seinem Panzer. Ein böser Blick und seine Feinde verstummen.

en-US.text: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

es-ES.text: Derriba a su rival con un solo tajo del sable que lleva en su coraza. Acalla al enemigo con una simple mirada.

fr-FR.text: Il peut terrasser ses ennemis d’un coup de la lame enchâssée dans son armure, et les faire taire d’un seul regard.

it-IT.text: Atterra l’avversario con un solo colpo della spada inserita nell’armatura. Una sua occhiata ammutolisce il nemico.

pt-PT.text: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

zh-CN.text: 拔刀术的高手。会用收在前腿铠甲里的大刀一剑定胜负。

de-DE.text: Eines dieser vorsichtigen Pokémon steht immer vor ihrem Bau Wache. Nähert sich jedoch ein Feind von hinten, ist es aus.

en-US.text: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.

es-ES.text: Aunque es un Pokémon muy precavido y siempre hay uno montando guardia, si se acercan por detrás, no se dará cuenta.

fr-FR.text: Très prudent, il surveille attentivement son territoire, mais oublie souvent de regarder derrière lui.

it-IT.text: Sono molto guardinghi e almeno uno del branco è sempre di guardia. Non vedono però il nemico se li attacca da dietro.

pt-PT.text: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.

zh-CN.text: 会在颊囊里藏食物，连续放哨好几天。用尾巴给伙伴发出暗号。

de-DE.text: Bespuckt Gegner mit Kernen von Beeren aus seinen Backentaschen. Erspäht es einen Feind, richtet es den Schweif auf.

en-US.text: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

es-ES.text: Ataca lanzando las semillas de las bayas que acumula en sus mofletes. Su cola se tensa al avistar a un enemigo.

fr-FR.text: Il attaque en crachant les graines des Baies qu’il accumule dans ses bajoues. S’il voit un ennemi, il dresse la queue.

it-IT.text: Attacca sparando i semi delle bacche che ha accumulato nelle guance. Se avvista il nemico, drizza la coda.

pt-PT.text: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

zh-CN.text: 用体内的发光物质让眼珠和身体闪闪发光，使来袭的敌人畏缩。

de-DE.text: Yorkleff ist deutlich intelligenter als die meisten Kinder und vergisst nie, wenn man ihm Zuneigung entgegenbringt oder es schlecht behandelt.

en-US.text: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

es-ES.text: Muestra una inteligencia muy superior a la media de los niños humanos. No olvida ni el amor ni los malos tratos que recibe.

fr-FR.text: Ce Pokémon est plus intelligent que la plupart des enfants. Il n’oublie ni l’affection qu’il a reçue ni les mauvais traitements qu’il a pu subir.

it-IT.text: È molto più intelligente di un bambino. Non scorda né l’affetto ricevuto né i maltrattamenti subiti.

pt-PT.text: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

zh-CN.text: 比普通的小孩子还要聪明许多。对于得到的关爱和受到的伤害都不会忘怀。

de-DE.text: Das dunkle Fell, das seinen Körper bedeckt, ist sehr dicht und federnd. Selbst Angriffe mit scharfen Fangzähnen prallen davon ab.

en-US.text: The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

es-ES.text: El pelaje negro que lo recubre es tan denso y elástico que puede repeler incluso los colmillos más afilados.

fr-FR.text: Les poils sombres qui recouvrent son dos sont si épais et si souples qu’ils peuvent même repousser des crocs acérés.

it-IT.text: La pelliccia scura che ricopre il suo corpo è spessa ed elastica, al punto da respingere anche delle zanne affilate.

pt-PT.text: The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

zh-CN.text: 覆盖在身上的黑色体毛既厚又有弹性，甚至能把尖锐的牙齿也反弹回去。

de-DE.text: Seinen üppigen Schnauzbart trägt es mit Stolz. Angeblich entscheidet dessen Länge über die Rangordnung innerhalb dieser Pokémon-Art.

en-US.text: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It’s said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.

es-ES.text: Sus impresionantes bigotes son su orgullo. Entre los de su especie se establece una jerarquía según su longitud.

fr-FR.text: Sa moustache remarquable fait sa fierté, car sa longueur permettrait de déterminer la hiérarchie au sein de l’espèce.

it-IT.text: Va molto fiero dei suoi splendidi baffi. Si dice che la loro lunghezza determini la sua superiorità o inferiorità rispetto ai suoi simili.

pt-PT.text: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It’s said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.

zh-CN.text: 以自己气派的胡须为傲。据说，每只个体在族群中的地位，就是根据胡须长度来决定的。

de-DE.text: Es wiegt andere durch liebenswertes Verhalten in Sicherheit, kratzt sie dann plötzlich und amüsiert sich prächtig darüber.

en-US.text: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

es-ES.text: Una vez que ha logrado distraer al rival mediante sus gestos adorables, lo araña de improviso con las garras mientras muestra un semblante risueño.

fr-FR.text: Malheur à qui se laisse berner par ses gestes adorables : une fois les gens à sa portée, il les griffe sans crier gare, en ricanant.

it-IT.text: Lascia avvicinare il nemico distraendolo con pose ammalianti, e poi all’improvviso lo graffia ridendo.

pt-PT.text: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

zh-CN.text: 会用可爱的动作让对手放下戒心，趁对方靠过来时冷不防地用爪子猛抓，然后得意地大笑。

de-DE.text: Dieses Pokémon schleicht sich völlig geräuschlos von hinten an seine Beute heran. Es bestreitet Revierkämpfe mit Gaunux.

en-US.text: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.

es-ES.text: Libra disputas territoriales con los Thievul. Se acerca a sus rivales por la espalda sin hacer el menor ruido.

fr-FR.text: Sans un bruit, il approche ses victimes par-derrière pour les frapper. Il dispute son territoire avec les Roublenard.

it-IT.text: Si avvicina di soppiatto alla preda, attaccandola alle spalle all’improvviso. Spesso si contende il territorio con Thievul.

pt-PT.text: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.

zh-CN.text: 和猾大狐争抢地盘。能够悄无声息地从背后偷偷靠近猎物。

de-DE.text: Ein nettes Kerlchen, das so talentiert darin ist, Beeren aufzuspüren, dass es sie mit all seinen Kameraden teilt.

en-US.text: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.

es-ES.text: Es todo un experto en la búsqueda de bayas y es tan gentil que las comparte con todos sus compañeros.

fr-FR.text: Il est très doué pour trouver des Baies et aime les partager avec ses amis sans rien demander en échange.

it-IT.text: È un Pokémon molto generoso. Abilissimo nello scovare le bacche, va in giro a raccoglierle per poi condividerle.

pt-PT.text: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.

zh-CN.text: 会把头上的叶子分给没有精神的宝可梦。具有缓解疲劳的效果。

de-DE.text: Ein hitziger Geselle, der im Kampf seinen dornigen Schweif umherschwingt. Auf seinem Kopf wachsen bittere Kräuter.

en-US.text: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

es-ES.text: Pokémon muy temperamental que lucha con su cola revestida de púas. Las hojas de su cabeza están muy amargas.

fr-FR.text: Il a un tempérament violent et se bat avec sa queue pleine d’épines. La feuille sur sa tête est très amère.

it-IT.text: Di carattere impetuoso, lotta roteando la coda dotata di aculei. Le foglie che ha sul capo sono molto amare.

pt-PT.text: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

zh-CN.text: 用带有很多尖刺的尾巴摔打对手进行攻击。是性格很粗暴的宝可梦。

de-DE.text: Das Feuer in seinem Kopfbüschel erreicht Temperaturen von bis zu 300 °C. Es ist in Vulkanhöhlen zu Hause.

en-US.text: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

es-ES.text: Vive en cuevas volcánicas. El interior de su mata de pelo arde, llegando a alcanzar hasta 300 °C.

fr-FR.text: Il vit dans les cratères des volcans. L’intérieur de la mèche qu’il a sur la tête peut atteindre 300 °C.

it-IT.text: Vive nelle grotte vulcaniche. L’interno del ciuffo che ha in testa brucia a una temperatura di 300 °C.

pt-PT.text: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

zh-CN.text: 智商很高，有着将树果烤熟后再吃的习性。很喜爱给人类帮忙。

de-DE.text: Freut es sich, erhitzt sich sein Körper und aus seinem Kopf und Schweif sprühen Funken. Es liebt Süßigkeiten.

en-US.text: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

es-ES.text: Cuando se emociona, echa chispas por la cola y la cabeza, y calienta su cuerpo. Por alguna razón le encantan los dulces.

fr-FR.text: Quand il est excité, des flammèches brûlantes dansent sur sa tête et sa queue. Il raffole des choses sucrées.

it-IT.text: Quando è concitato si scalda e iniziano a levarsi scintille dalla testa e dalla coda. Per qualche motivo adora i dolci.

pt-PT.text: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

zh-CN.text: 燃烧体内的火焰，从头和尾巴纷纷扬扬地撒出火花，把敌人都烧焦。

de-DE.text: Das Wasser, das es im Büschel auf seinem Kopf sammelt, ist äußerst nahrhaft und verhilft Pflanzen zu großem Wachstum.

en-US.text: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

es-ES.text: La acuosidad que acumula en su mata de pelo es rica en nutrientes, ideal para regar plantas y que crezcan mucho.

fr-FR.text: L’eau contenue dans la mèche sur sa tête est pleine de nutriments. Elle fait pousser les plantes avec vigueur.

it-IT.text: L’acqua accumulata nel ciuffo è ricca di nutrimento e fa crescere rigogliose le piante che ne vengono annaffiate.

pt-PT.text: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

zh-CN.text: 头上的毛发丛里储藏的水充满了营养。会用尾巴给草木浇这种水。

de-DE.text: Hält sich bevorzugt in reinen Gewässern auf. Geht ihm das Wasser in seinem Kopf aus, tankt es mit seinem Schweif nach.

en-US.text: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

es-ES.text: Le encantan los lugares con agua limpia. Cuando desciende el nivel de agua de su pelo, se abastece a través de su cola.

fr-FR.text: Il aime les endroits où l’eau est pure. Il se ravitaille en eau en l’aspirant avec sa queue.

it-IT.text: Predilige i luoghi dove l’acqua è pura. Se l’acqua che ha sul capo diminuisce, ne aggiunge altra aspirandola con la coda.

pt-PT.text: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

zh-CN.text: 如果从尾巴发射出高压水，那威力甚至能破坏混凝土墙壁。

de-DE.text: Während es Träume frisst, stößt es Dunst aus. Bei fröhlichen Träumen ist dieser rosafarben, bei Alpträumen schwärzlich.

en-US.text: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it’s eating a good dream, and black when it’s eating a nightmare.

es-ES.text: El humo que despide cambia de color en función del sueño que haya consumido. Si es alegre, será rosa, o negruzco en el caso de una pesadilla.

fr-FR.text: Il se nourrit de songes et expire de la fumée qui prend la couleur rose si le rêve est joyeux, ou noire s’il s’agit d’un cauchemar.

it-IT.text: Si nutre di sogni. Esala un fumo rosa se sono sogni piacevoli e nero se sono incubi.

pt-PT.text: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it’s eating a good dream, and black when it’s eating a nightmare.

zh-CN.text: 在吃掉梦之后会吐出烟雾。吃了快乐的梦时，烟雾是粉红色的；如果是噩梦，烟雾则是黑灰色的。

de-DE.text: Es schlummert und träumt immerzu. Wenn es geweckt wird, bekommt es schlechte Laune. Deshalb sollte man es lieber in Ruhe lassen.

en-US.text: It drowses and dreams all the time. It’s best to leave it be if it’s just woken up, as it’s a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

es-ES.text: Siempre está soñando o adormecido. Se pone de muy mal humor al despertar, por lo que es mejor no perturbarlo.

fr-FR.text: Il est sans cesse assoupi, plongé dans ses rêves. Il vaut mieux éviter de le déranger, car il est toujours mal luné au réveil.

it-IT.text: Sonnecchia costantemente, sognando. Quando si sveglia è di pessimo umore, quindi è meglio tenersi a debita distanza.

pt-PT.text: It drowses and dreams all the time. It’s best to leave it be if it’s just woken up, as it’s a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

zh-CN.text: 总是在打瞌睡做梦。刚睡醒的时候会闹脾气，所以最好别去招惹它。

de-DE.text: Sie sind vergesslich und nicht besonders clever, aber da sie sehr zutraulich und fleißig sind, haben viele Trainer sie ins Herz geschlossen.

en-US.text: It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.

es-ES.text: Es muy olvidadizo y no demasiado avispado, pero muchos Entrenadores le tienen simpatía por su carácter afable y sincero.

fr-FR.text: Il n’est pas très malin et un peu distrait, mais beaucoup de Dresseurs l’apprécient pour son caractère affectueux et sa bonne volonté.

it-IT.text: È un po’ smemorato e non molto sveglio. Tuttavia è diligente e si affeziona facilmente, e per questo molti Allenatori lo adorano.

pt-PT.text: It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.

zh-CN.text: 虽然既健忘又不太聪明，因为性格认真且容易亲近人，所以受到了许多训练家的喜爱。

de-DE.text: Es ist clever und hat ein gutes Gedächtnis. Anscheinend wird es von vielen Lieferanten als Partner ausgewählt.

en-US.text: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.

es-ES.text: Posee una mente ágil y muy buena memoria. Tal vez por eso muchos repartidores lo eligen como compañero.

fr-FR.text: Il est intelligent et possède une bonne mémoire. On raconte que les livreurs le choisissent souvent comme partenaire.

it-IT.text: Pokémon intelligente, dotato di una memoria di ferro. Sembra che molti fattorini lo scelgano come compagno.

pt-PT.text: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.

zh-CN.text: 头脑聪明而且记性很好。似乎有许多快递员将它选为自己的搭档。

de-DE.text: Es ist schlau, aber auch sehr stolz. Seine Trainer genießen daher generell großen Respekt.

en-US.text: This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.

es-ES.text: Es un Pokémon muy inteligente y orgulloso. Se tiene en alta estima a aquellos que se convierten en sus Entrenadores.

fr-FR.text: Ce Pokémon est aussi intelligent qu’il est arrogant. Les Dresseurs de Déflaisan sont tenus en haute estime.

it-IT.text: È tanto intelligente quanto orgoglioso. Diventare Allenatori di questo Pokémon equivale a guadagnarsi il rispetto e l’ammirazione di tutti.

pt-PT.text: This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.

zh-CN.text: 头脑聪明，所以自尊心也强。如果能成为高傲雉鸡的训练家，所有人都会对你刮目相看。

de-DE.text: Um mit Artgenossen zu kommunizieren, nutzt es das Aufblitzen seiner Mähne beim Entladen von Strom als Morsecode.

en-US.text: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

es-ES.text: Su crin brilla cuando emite una descarga eléctrica. Se comunica con los suyos mediante el ritmo y el número de brillos.

fr-FR.text: Sa crinière luit quand il lâche des décharges. Il module leur rythme et leur nombre pour communiquer avec ses pairs.

it-IT.text: Se emette scariche la sua criniera brilla. Comunica con i suoi simili tramite il ritmo e la frequenza delle pulsazioni luminose.

pt-PT.text: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

zh-CN.text: 用心跳来发电。受惊导致心跳加速时，电压也会随之上升。

de-DE.text: Es ist explosiv wie ein Blitz. Galoppiert es mit voller Geschwindigkeit drauflos, kann man Donnerhall vernehmen.

en-US.text: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

es-ES.text: Su velocidad se asemeja a la de un rayo. Si corre al máximo, se dejan oír truenos por doquier.

fr-FR.text: Il réagit à la vitesse de l’éclair. Lorsqu’il est en plein galop, on peut entendre le grondement du tonnerre.

it-IT.text: È scattante come una saetta. Se corre alla massima velocità, si sente un rimbombo di tuoni.

pt-PT.text: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

zh-CN.text: 性格暴躁充满攻击性。兴奋起来时，就会让鬃毛亮起黄色光芒并放出电击。

de-DE.text: Es bewegt sich stets auf Geräuschquellen zu. Dank seines Energiekerns fühlt es sich immer leicht warm an, wenn man es berührt.
